mapper.select: SELECT wc.CORP_GR , wc.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , wc.TR_CO_CD , wc.TR_SEQ_NO , wc.TR_AEK , wc.TR_YMD , wc.TR_CD , wc.TRUSTEE , wc.CURRENCY , wc.FCUR_TR_AEK FROM SST0WC wc JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = wc.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = wc.FUND_CD WHERE wc.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND wc.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND wc.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND wc.CURRENCY = 'KRW' ORDER BY wc.TR_YMD, wc.FUND_CD, wc.TR_CD, wc.TR_SEQ_NO
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM SST0WC t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.CURRENCY = 'KRW' AND t1.TR_CD IN (SELECT tr_cd FROM SZX1PT WHERE obj_id = 'W_JA031C') ORDER BY 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SST0WC ( CORP_GR, FUND_CD, TR_CO_CD, TR_SEQ_NO, TR_AEK, TR_YMD, TR_CD, TRUSTEE, CURRENCY, FCUR_TR_AEK ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, #{fundCd}, #{trCoCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trSeqNo}, NVL(#{trAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), #{trYmd}, #{trCd}, 'KRW', 'KRW', NVL(#{fcurTrAek, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) )
